title: Siren of the Arcane Sea
description: A purple-skinned female figure with a flower crown stands behind a curved white counter, levitating a glowing red orb between her hands. The purple-walled room is filled with framed paintings of ocean waves, seashells, and red poppies, with large arched windows revealing a bright blue underwater scene.
prompt: A purple-skinned mystical woman with long dark hair and a red flower crown stands in an ornate purple room, holding a glowing red magical orb between her hands. She wears a cream and green patterned robe. The curved counter in front of her is covered in red runes and holds old books and a glass dome containing a scroll with red poppies. The walls are covered with multiple framed paintings of ocean waves, seashells, and vibrant red poppies. Bright light streams through large arched windows showing an underwater scene, with bubbles floating in the air.
